ember.note: Set in CSS as --hd-focus. --hd-ember holds the same value but no rule reads it.

display.purpose: The statement at the gate on desktop. Archivo 900, width 86%, 3em measure, one fire mark.

headline.purpose: The plain heading (h1) under a figurative statement.

lead.purpose: The main sentence of a panel with no form.

small.purpose: Help text under a task, muted.

note.purpose: The development build note and fact labels.

mono-host.purpose: The host on the gate plaque.

mono-value.purpose: A fact value, for example the redirect host.

themes.name: night
themes.purpose: The default scene. Stars, a near-black sky, a dark gatehouse. Frontmatter keys without a suffix.

themes.name: day
themes.purpose: A dawn sky, deeper lapis bands, a white panel, no stars. Frontmatter keys with the -day suffix.

themes.name: forced-colors
themes.purpose: The bridge is hidden. Buttons, inputs, the panel, the problem box, and the fact box get a 2px CanvasText border (buttons ButtonText). Focus uses Highlight. The on track of the motion switch fills with Highlight.

shadows.name: invalid-field
shadows.purpose: Doubles the fire border of an invalid input to 2px. A border, not elevation.

focus.purpose: The ember ring on every focusable element. Inputs use offset 0 and an ember border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition (--hd-ease-out).

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button fill and input border changes.

motion.name: arrow
motion.purpose: The go arrow moves 4px on hover.

motion.name: fire-color
motion.purpose: The fire mark, the ember thread, and the guard band change color.

motion.name: guard-flare
motion.purpose: The guard band widens from 16 to 44 on a refusal.

motion.name: idle-drift
motion.purpose: Idle: a soft light drifts up each band.

motion.name: twinkle
motion.purpose: Idle: the stars twinkle. Every seventh star holds still.

motion.name: busy-flow
motion.purpose: Busy: a stream of lights runs up every band.

motion.name: burn
motion.purpose: Refused: the fire glow flickers under the bands.

motion.name: crossing
motion.purpose: Crossing: every band lights from the gate to the sky.

motion.name: motion-off
motion.purpose: The motion switch (default from prefers-reduced-motion, choice in localStorage key heimdall.motion) stops the scene. Crossing stays lit; refused keeps the fire. prefers-reduced-motion also sets every transition to 1ms.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: One column: wordmark, motion switch, statement, plaque, panel. Bridge is a corner arc at the top right.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: The phone order in a 34rem column. Larger corner arc.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Statement left, panel right (27.5rem), plaque bottom left, bridge behind the panel.

bridgeStates.name: idle
bridgeStates.bridge: Stars twinkle. Soft lights drift up the bands.

bridgeStates.name: busy
bridgeStates.when: Heimdall checks the password or loads a request.
bridgeStates.bridge: Fast lights run up every band, one after the other.

bridgeStates.name: refused
bridgeStates.when: Heimdall refuses (401, 429, an error page with a refusal), or the user selects Deny.
bridgeStates.bridge: The guard band turns fire red and widens, a glow burns, the frost dims to 55%, no light moves. The panel border and the fire mark turn red.

bridgeStates.name: crossing
bridgeStates.when: Sign-in or Allow succeeded; the browser is about to leave.
bridgeStates.bridge: Every band lights from the gate to the sky, once.

extensions.scope: Heimdall's account pages only (ui/projects/account, ui/projects/ui-kit). The demo SPA is a client, not Heimdall, and keeps the old U13 look in ui/projects/demo/src/client-kit.css.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Burning Bridge"**

In the myths, Heimdall guards Bifröst, the burning bridge to Asgard. Each account page is the gate at the foot of that bridge. The page shows three things: the host where the user stands, one decision, and a bridge that shows the state of the request. The owner approved this world on 2026-10-23 (decision U15 in `docs/frontend-design.md`). It replaces "The Public-Service Notice" (U13).

The scene is dark and still by default, with a few cold stars. Frost bands make a quarter arc behind the task. An ember thread burns along the arc at rest. The page is flat and square. Size and weight rank the content, not boxes or shadows. One very large statement in Archivo 900 stands at the left, like a sign at the gate. The task sits in one flat gatehouse panel.

The bridge is decoration with a job. It shows the state of the crossing, but no state depends on it. The text, the focus, and `aria-live` carry every state. The world rejects the centered SaaS card on a gradient.

The tokens and the frame are in `ui/projects/ui-kit` (`styles/heimdall.css`, `HdGate`, `HdBridge`, `HdMotionSwitch`, `HdIcon`). Tenant branding (Phase 3) changes token values, never a component.

**Scope.** This system covers Heimdall's own pages only: login, consent, error, and signed out (`ui/projects/account`). The demo SPA is a client, not Heimdall. It keeps the old U13 look in `ui/projects/demo/src/client-kit.css`, so a user can see that it is a different site. Huginn and every other client are also out of this system.
keyCharacteristics: Three color meanings: frost, ember, and fire. Each color means one thing on every page.
Night (the default scene) and day themes from `prefers-color-scheme`.
The bridge is state: idle, busy, refused, crossing.
A visible "Motion" switch stops all movement.
Archivo 900 statement at 86% width, tight tracking. JetBrains Mono only for machine values.
Square controls, 56px tall. No radius anywhere.
The gate plaque names the host and asks the user to compare it with the address bar.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Frost is the bridge and Heimdall's actions. Ember is the bridge's fire at rest and keyboard focus. Fire red is a refusal. Use no color for a second meaning.

rules.name: The Fire Means No Rule
rules.body: Red appears only when Heimdall refuses or the user selects Deny: wrong credentials, the throttle, an error page with a refusal. A "Heimdall is busy" error is not a refusal, so it stays idle and has no red.

rules.name: The Tokens Not Components Rule
rules.body: A theme or a tenant changes token values only. Components read `var(--hd-*)`.

rules.name: The Machine Value Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono only for hosts, codes, client IDs, scope names, and input text. Never use it for prose or headings.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: A figurative statement ("Gate shut.") always has a plain heading under it that says the same thing ("Heimdall does not know this app").

rules.name: The Fire Mark Rule
rules.body: A statement ends with one punctuation mark in the fire span (`.` or `?`). The mark is ember at rest and fire red on a refusal. Use no other colored glyph in the statement.

rules.name: The First Screen Rule
rules.body: The motion switch and the primary action are in the first screen on every layout.

rules.name: The Flat Gate Rule
rules.body: No drop shadow on any component. Separate surfaces with a 1px line or a fill change.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No radius on any control, box, or tile, including the logo tile.

dos: **Do** use frost for the bridge and Heimdall's actions, ember for the fire at rest and keyboard focus, and fire red for a refusal only (The One Meaning Rule).
**Do** show the host on the gate plaque in JetBrains Mono, with the line "Check that your address bar shows the same host."
**Do** put a plain heading under every figurative statement, and make that heading the `h1`.
**Do** set the display in Archivo 900 at 86% width, line height 0.86, tracking -0.045em, with a 3em measure on desktop.
**Do** make every control square and 56px tall (60px for buttons).
**Do** set the bridge state from the page state, and also say that state in text.
**Do** keep the motion switch in the first screen. Default it from `prefers-reduced-motion`, and keep the state readable with motion off.
**Do** give every edge and state a system-color border in forced-colors mode, and hide the bridge there.
**Do** serve fonts and every other asset from Heimdall's own origin.
donts: **Don't** use red for anything but a refusal. A busy or unavailable state is not a refusal.
**Don't** use ember for anything but the bridge's fire, the fire mark, and keyboard focus.
**Don't** round a corner, add a drop shadow, or add a gradient to a control or a panel.
**Don't** use JetBrains Mono for prose or headings.
**Don't** make any state depend on the bridge. Text, focus, and `aria-live` must carry it.
**Don't** center the task in a card on a gradient.
**Don't** use this look in a client app. The demo SPA and Huginn are not Heimdall, and the demo SPA keeps its own look in `ui/projects/demo/src/client-kit.css`.
**Don't** load a font or any other file from a third-party origin.
